prompts.speaking:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production four-frame speaking animation atlas for a children's Polish alphabet toy on a 240x320 portrait ST7789 LCD. Replace the speaking character with Mała Mi (Little My), faithfully reflecting the original 1990 hand-drawn Moomin anime facial design and talking mouth.
Input images: image 1 (Ć letter card) is the project's watercolor/ink rendering style and Little My identity reference only: omit the letter completely. Images 2 and 3 are original anime screenshots to STUDY HER EXACT MOUTH SHAPES, face proportions, straight forehead fringe, eyebrows and pointed nose. Do not reproduce scenes, windows, furniture, words, backgrounds, another character, or screenshot artifacts.
Create ONE square atlas split into exactly four equal square quadrants in a 2x2 grid, no gaps or borders. Each quadrant contains a whole-body Little My at the exact same scale and coordinates, fixed camera, fixed hairline, nose, eyes, dress, arms and boots. Generous margins so no part is cut. Large round head, tiny short body, orange-red topknot with straight fringe, sharp small pointed triangular nose, side-looking eyes with green irises, slightly lowered mischievous eyebrows, bright red flared dress with large pale pink neck bow, black gloves and short black lace-up boots. One black-gloved hand on hip, other hand lightly raised in an assertive conversational gesture; the gesture does not change between frames, so the animation focuses on mouth movement. Familiar cheeky determined Little My, not a generic cute girl.
Mouth anatomy from the 1990 references: NO sculpted lips, NO lipstick, NO modern anime pout. A fine black contour and a simple pink/reddish interior. Keep mouth in the lower center of her round face, under her small pointed nose, clearly visible at LCD size. Four different sequential mouth shapes, in reading order: TOP LEFT closed sly smile, just a thin asymmetric curved black line; TOP RIGHT shallow sideways open wedge with pink interior, upper edge almost straight/slightly angled, curved lower contour matching screenshot 2; BOTTOM LEFT modest taller open pink oval/bean, contour matching screenshot 3, not an exaggerated giant laughing mouth and no teeth; BOTTOM RIGHT small horizontally narrow opening like end of a spoken syllable, which naturally transitions back to the closed smile. Do not draw full red lips around any mouth. All other facial geometry stays IDENTICAL across frames; only the mouth changes.
Style: soft clean ink contour with subtle watercolor coloring, consistent with the project's letter card and listening animation. Pale ivory background #fffdf5, very faint mint watercolor wash around the figure, no scenery or props. No letters, text, speech bubbles, numbers, labels or watermark. Preserve square quadrant alignment. The frames will be fitted without stretching to240x320 and shown at5FPS, a0.8second loop.
prompts.listening:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: image 1 is the existing Moominmamma four-frame animation atlas. Reference image 2 shows her existing base pose. Improve ONLY animation registration and consistency. Preserve the existing watercolor/ink style, ivory/mint background, proportions, white Moominmamma, striped apron, black handbag, tail, and listening action. Output one square 2x2 atlas with exactly FOUR equal quadrants, no dividers, gaps, text or labels.
CRITICAL: This is a LOCKED-CAMERA IN-PLACE ANIMATION, not four independent illustrations. Copy the EXACT same lower body, apron stripes, handbag position, apron bow, tail, feet and grounding from top-left into all four quadrants. The artwork's lower part is identical in every quadrant. Within each quadrant the same apron bottom edge, foot contours and soles must occupy the EXACT same relative pixel coordinates. Feet never slide, lift, spread, grow, move up/down or left/right. Character never shifts or changes scale. No camera pan, zoom, recentering or reframing. Background mint wash is IDENTICAL in each quadrant. Use top-left as the master alignment for the other three, rather than individually centering poses. Local positions: feet span approx 36%-70% of cell width, sole baseline near94% of cell height in ALL four cells, body center near53% cell width. Preserve generous margins and whole figure.
Animate ONLY the raised forearm, upper shoulder/neck, tiny head tilt, and eyelids. Keep her handbag-holding arm and torso base anchored. Top-left: original relaxed listening posture, free paw at chest. Top-right: free paw raises toward her ear. Bottom-left: free hand cups ear with a small believable neck/head tilt pivoting from fixed shoulder, anchored hip and planted feet. Bottom-right: same hand cupped at ear, gentle blink, slight attentive upper-body movement pivoted from anchored waist. No translation of the entire body. Face and expression remain faithful, gentle and alert. Head position changes only as part of a tiny anatomical tilt, not whole-character drift. Do not redesign her or change her scale between frames. Keep the bottom-half silhouette, feet, handbag, tail and background precisely repeated. Readable at240x320 and5FPS.

mouthReferenceSources.observation: Simple shallow asymmetric open wedge, a curved lower contour, and reddish interior; no distinct painted lip outline.
Small pink rounded oval during speech, with a fine dark outline and no separate modeled lips.

Output one 2x2 square atlas, same dimensions and character/style. Treat this as animation cel compositing, NOT four redraws.
For each square quadrant use the EXACT LOWER HALF of the TOP-LEFT quadrant, duplicated at IDENTICAL LOCAL COORDINATES into all other quadrants. All content below the waist/apron rim, including apron stripes, handbag, apron bow, tail, feet and ground wash, is a frozen identical base. Baseline, hip, apron hem and bottom toes must stay pixel-registered. Do not independently recenter or resize any quadrant. Copy the first frame bottom-half three times rather than drawing another lower body. Top-row lower body is the correct reference; bottom-row lower body is the part to REPLACE.
Above this identical base preserve the four current listening movements: frame0 paw near chest, frame1 hand rising toward ear, frame2 cupping ear and tiny neck tilt, frame3 cupping ear and blinking. Do not add props, text, borders or labels. The result should play like the same planted mother moving her arm and head, not jumping between four drawings.
